methodology: Pinned Motoko ECDSA 8.0.1 adapters for the exact same valid compact low-S signature, compressed key and 32-byte digest as the corresponding plugin controls. Decoding and validation remain timed.

cases.name: api-secp256k1-verifyPrehash-ecdsa
cases.notes: Byte-oriented composition of pinned ecdsa@8.0.1 APIs. Input decoding, strict length/range validation, operation, SEC1/DER/compact serialization and array-to-Blob conversion are measured. Only reusable curve construction and immutable input literals are outside timing. Fixture comes from the independent frozen curve oracle; no plugin outputs were used. Typed error text differs from the native API; comparison is for this valid input. ecdsa Signature normalizes S before verifyHashed; this low-S fixture has identical ECDSA semantics. Package P-256 has a half-order boundary quirk, so this row does not assert complete validation equivalence.
